summary: Round-29 independent arbitration of case `capability-control-plane-markdown-capability-schema` (gate exit 0, per-case evidence digest sha256:1d135bb19b3e1ac8de942fbaba799b4b5bea255bf0cc95b7e65138c4abc701dc; EC inventory digest sha256:1c5c708970f2fd0a3eaec7f2c948fca177e91ce32570988556950a7d97b59139). THIS IS AGENT ARBITRATION INPUT, NOT HUMAN-BACKED ACCEPTANCE EVIDENCE; the production gate still requires the human batch audit. Method: 19 anchored single-occurrence mutations of apps/agentic-workflow/src/cli/capability.rs (M178-M196), each rebuilt with `rustup run stable cargo build -p agentic-workflow --bin aw` and adjudicated only by the declared gate's exit code, restored in a finally. 3 KILLED (M179, M180, M185 -- the last a deliberate control confirming the durable claim that both feature roots are emitted exactly when the input classified something), 16 SURVIVED, 0 compile failures. Reachability of the surviving arms was then confirmed against the unmutated binary at HEAD with five throwaway `aw capability migrate` probes, so none of these findings rests on an unreachable arm. The recurring class the last seven rounds keep re-instancing recurs again and is the through-line of every finding here: round 28 bound the `Surfaces:` emptiness guard in the direction of absence, and the two sibling conditional fields in the same renderer -- `Type:` and `EC Dimensions:` -- were left free in exactly that direction (M182, M178 both survived; a probe shows the product legally emits neither for a `candidate`). The same shape repeats one level down at five more sites: all three synthesized no-work-root-table rows (M184/M187/M188), the whole `normalize_surface_kind` alias map (M191 -- the exact sibling of the Feature Class human-spelling waves the durable evidence boasts about), the `parse_ec_dimension_kind` alias arms whose failure silently DROPS the dimension item through a filter_map (M192), the attach arm of `merge_efficiency_backfill_slot` that the fixture's own import-time assertion deliberately excludes (M193), and all three `ensure_canonical_readme_scaffold` repairs (M194/M195/M196) -- the frame the relocation leg pins as a literal is unbound one path over on format migration, where a probe shows a document lacking `## Capabilities` has its authored Brief prose silently destroyed at exit 0. Two derivation arms are unbound for lack of an input status (`Confirmed`, `Retired` in capability_verification_summary: M186, M181), one for lack of a non-verified all-closed capability (capability_impl_summary: M190), one for lack of a capability omitting `Required Verification:` (capability_maturity_summary: M189), and one for lack of an empty registry (the legacy `break`: M183). Separately, one durable evidence sentence is FALSE about the fixture as it now stands: the assertion label at migration_clusters/capability_manual.py claims values 'made pairwise distinct per capability, down to the surface kind and the EC dimension kind', but MEMBER_EC_DIMENSION (lumen_feature_class_reference.py:366-374) assigns `behavior` to three of seven members and `stability` to two, and the file's own import-time assert only requires the set to cover the enum. Not a coverage claim: assertion_count/assertions_digest are a digest over a hardcoded label list (runner.py:104-109) and are cited nowhere here as evidence. Product source was mutated transiently only; after the campaign `git status --short apps/agentic-workflow/src/` is empty, the binary was rebuilt at HEAD, and the declared gate re-ran at exit 0.
findings: FALSE DURABLE EVIDENCE. The assertion label in migration_clusters/capability_manual.py that begins 'every rendered capability section carries its own Promise, Type, Required Verification, Surfaces, EC Dimensions, Gate Inventory, and Dependencies rather than a shared one' claims those values are 'made pairwise distinct per capability, down to the surface kind and the EC dimension kind'. That is false of the EC dimension kind: MEMBER_EC_DIMENSION (lumen_feature_class_reference.py:366-374) assigns `behavior` to Search Core, Kubernetes-Native Deployment AND Observability, and `stability` to both Standard Operational Endpoints and Contract Gate Wiring -- three-way and two-way collisions among seven members. The file's own guard at lines 375-380 only asserts the SET equals the four-value enum, which is a coverage property, not distinctness. The oracle string in pyproject.toml states the weaker and true version ('the dimensions asserted to walk the whole closed dimension enum'); the label states the stronger and false one. Revision: rewrite the label to claim exactly what the fixture supports -- surface kinds pairwise distinct, EC dimension kinds covering the closed enum -- or, if pairwise distinctness of the dimension kind is wanted, it cannot be had with seven members and four enum values, so the claim must be dropped rather than weakened silently.

ALL THREE SYNTHESIZED NO-WORK-ROOT-TABLE ROWS ARE UNBOUND. Rule: when a capability declares no work-root table, the renderer synthesizes rows -- one per verification-contract claim (capability.rs:9078-9090), one per gap (capability.rs:9092-9105), or a single `| {Title} root | epic | ... |` fallback (capability.rs:9107-9122). Mutations, all verbatim and all SURVIVED at gate exit 0: M184 `"| {} root | epic | {} | planned | planned | smoke | {} |
"` -> `"| {} rooot | epic | {} | planned | planned | smoke | {} |
"`; M187 `"| {} | epic | {} | {} | {} | smoke | {} |
"` -> `"| {}X | epic | {} | {} | {} | smoke | {} |
"`; M188 `"| {} | epic | {} | {} | {} | {} | {} |
"` -> `"| {}X | epic | {} | {} | {} | {} | {} |
"`. Why the fixture cannot observe them: `_capability` (lumen_feature_class_reference.py:106-122, 164-166) always emits a `| Work Root | Kind | WI | Impl | Verification | Maturity | Gate / Evidence |` header plus at least one row, so the whole no-table branch is dead against every document in the case. Reachability confirmed: a `candidate` capability with no work-root table migrates at exit 0 and renders `| Delta root | epic | - | planned | planned | smoke | tech-design/delta.md |` (probe E). These rows are what a re-report reads as the capability's claims, so a corrupted Work Root cell is silent data loss on a legal input. Revision: give one relocation document a capability that declares no work-root table at all and assert its rendered table as the exact ordered row list, on a document that also declares a table-bearing capability so 'some table survived' cannot answer for both; add a second capability whose gaps or claims drive the other two arms.

UNBOUND ALIAS CANONICALIZATION OF SURFACE KIND -- the exact sibling of the Feature Class human-spelling waves the durable evidence boasts about, on the field beside it. Rule: `normalize_surface_kind` (capability.rs:11692-11703) folds the human spellings `command`/`commands` to `CLI`, `api`/`rest` to `HTTP`, `webui`/`web` to `UI`, `configuration` to `Config`, `file`/`format` to `FileFormat`; `is_surface_contract_key` (capability.rs:11381-11407) deliberately ACCEPTS those spellings as authored input. Mutation M191 (verbatim): replace the entire `match normalize_table_token(value).as_str() { "cli" | "command" | "commands" => "CLI", "http" | "api" | "rest" => "HTTP", "sdk" => "SDK", "ui" | "webui" | "web" => "UI", "config" | "configuration" => "Config", "fileformat" | "file" | "format" => "FileFormat", _ => value.trim(), }.to_string()` with `value.trim().to_string()`. Verdict: SURVIVED at gate exit 0. Why the fixture cannot observe it: every value in MEMBER_SURFACE_KIND (lumen_feature_class_reference.py:347-355) is already canonical -- HTTP, CLI, Probe, Kubernetes, Identity, MCP, OTLP -- so five of the seven fall through `_ => value.trim()` and the two that do enter the map are identities. The whole map is a no-op on this fixture. Reachability confirmed against the unmutated binary: a capability declaring `- Commands: \`aw alpha\` - alpha CLI surface` migrates at exit 0 and renders `- CLI: \`aw alpha\` - alpha CLI surface` (probe A). Revision: declare one capability whose `Surfaces:` item uses a non-canonical accepted spelling (`Commands:`, `API:`, `Web:`) and assert the rendered item comes back with the canonical kind, in the same one-spelling-per-capability wave form already used for Feature Class -- the durable evidence names that wave technique explicitly for one field and never applies it to this one.

PRODUCT DEFECT THE FIXTURE CANNOT SEE, ADJACENT TO THE PREVIOUS FINDING: format migration of a document that has no `## Capabilities` heading DESTROYS the authored Brief prose. Probed against the unmutated binary at HEAD: input `# Demo / ## Brief / Probe C. / ### Core Features / #### Gamma ...` migrates at exit 0 and the output contains no occurrence of `Probe C.` -- the Brief body is replaced by `<!-- TODO: Add the human-confirmed project brief before publishing. -->`. The identical document with `## Capabilities` inserted keeps its Brief verbatim (probe D), which localizes the loss to `prefix.trim().is_empty()` at capability.rs:8556 rebuilding the prefix as `# {project_display_name}` after the strip. Because every fixture document supplies `## Capabilities`, this case renders green over silent destruction of human-authored content. Revision: assert that format migration preserves authored prose above the contract on a document lacking `## Capabilities` -- and, if the product behavior is judged wrong rather than the assertion missing, file the product defect separately; the EC's obligation either way is to make the two outcomes distinguishable.

TWO ARMS OF `capability_verification_summary` ARE UNBOUND FOR LACK OF AN INPUT STATUS. Rule: capability.rs:9297-9306 maps `Confirmed => "planned"` and `Retired => "blocked"`. Mutations, verbatim: M186 `CapabilityStatus::Confirmed => "planned",` -> `CapabilityStatus::Confirmed => "verified",`; M181 `CapabilityStatus::Retired => "blocked",` -> `CapabilityStatus::Retired => "verified",`. Verdict: both SURVIVED at gate exit 0. Why the fixture cannot observe them: `assert_relocation_carries_per_capability_status` runs on the `varied_status` shape alone, and VARIED_STATUSES (lumen_feature_class_reference.py:3159-3166) is `("blocked", "verified", "candidate", "verified", "auditing", "verified")` -- no `confirmed`, no `retired` in the one document whose Impl/Verification columns are asserted. Both mutants make a capability the product does not consider verified report `verified` in the Capability Index, which is the column production readiness is read from. The durable evidence claims 'three distinct derived pairs across four statuses, so neither column can be a constant'; four of six enum members is not the closed enum. Revision: extend VARIED_STATUSES to cover all six `CapabilityStatus` values in the status-asserted document and pin the derived (Impl, Verification) pair for each, so the mapping is asserted as a total function rather than on the subset the fixture happens to declare.

THE `smoke` MATURITY FALLBACK IS UNBOUND. Rule: `capability_maturity_summary` (capability.rs:9826-9840) defaults a capability's maturity to `smoke` when it declares no `Required Verification:`. Mutation M189 (verbatim): `.unwrap_or_else(|| "smoke".to_string())` -> `.unwrap_or_else(|| "corpus".to_string())`. Verdict: SURVIVED at gate exit 0. Why the fixture cannot observe it: `_member_required_verification` returns a non-empty value for all seven members, so `_capability` (lumen_feature_class_reference.py:159) always writes the field and the fallback never runs. Reachability confirmed: a capability declaring no `Required Verification:` migrates at exit 0 and renders `Required Verification: smoke` plus Index Maturity `smoke` (probe E). Under the mutant the product silently promotes an undeclared capability to a stricter maturity than any author asked for, in the column the production gate reads. Revision: withhold `Required Verification:` from one capability of a relocation document and assert both its rendered field and its Index Maturity cell are exactly `smoke`, on a document where another capability declares a different value so the two cannot be confused.
